purpose: Synthetic accounting fixture, not a calibrated thesis workload

reasons.image_shape: Illustrative 4000x4000 RGB uint8 remote-sensing image; actual dataset sample must be recorded before formal evaluation
reasons.window_stride: Oriented R-CNN ICCV 2021 uses 1024x1024 crops with stride 824; this is a candidate, not a demonstrated quality optimum here
reasons.packet_grouping: 2x2 adjacent inference windows per scheduling packet; compare 1x1 and 4x4 with the same windows and total work
reasons.compute_cost_per_window: One abstract unit per window for accounting only; hardware service time is not measured
reasons.result_size_mb_per_window: Synthetic 1000 OBB records of 40 bytes each (8 float32 coordinates, float32 score, uint32 class), excluding headers; not measured detections or a dataset statistic
reasons.merge: Global detection deduplication is not run; aggregation_delay_s remains an explicit timing placeholder
